newsitem.title: USA: BC Texas to open 213 more Boston Market stores.
newsitem.headline: BC Texas to open 213 more Boston Market stores.

text.p: BC Texas Inc, the area developer of Boston Market in Texas, said Tuesday it plans to open 213 Boston Market stores over the next seven years.
The additional stores will raise the number of BC's Boston Market shops to 273.
The company said most of the new store locations will be in San Antonio, Corpus Christi, Midland-Odessa, Amarillo, Lubbock, Tyler, Beaumont, Waco, Temple, and Port Arthur.
BC Texas currently operates 60 Boston Market stores in Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston and Austin.
The company said when its development plans are complete, it will employ more than 8,000 people. It currently employs 1,800.
Boston Chicken Inc franchises, owns and operates Boston Market stores.
